description: This file implements a CheckpointReader class for reading and partially loading model checkpoints in a distributed machine learning setting, with functions for handling tensor data and checkpoint metadata.

classes.name: CheckpointReader
classes.description: Handles reading state dictionaries from storage, supporting full and partial checkpoint loading in distributed training.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a state dictionary from a checkpoint file, optionally partial.

methods.name: _partial_read
methods.description: Loads only the keys present in the provided state_dict from the checkpoint file, optimizing memory and load time.
